Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
In Tournament play, with a time limit, you
gain half a VP for surviving until time
runs out.

If I played a Life Boon on someone, would
I gain his half-point if the game went to
time (even if I'd been ousted, as per card
text)?

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
--

"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message
news:a3qv6.8004$De3.1...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net...



I'd guess you would get that ½ VP yes, but you can't gain VP if you've been
ousted, as stated on current cardtext.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If the game went to time and you were not ousted,
yes. If you had been ousted, then the Life Boon is
burned and has no effect when time is called.
